steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
initvault created vault FgNKkZHo… with the lab wallet as admin and six documented Pyth devnet feed addresses
Fetched the vault: admin and btc/eth feeds matched
initgames created games PDA 8F3BUi9Z… with count=0 and symbol [ZEROAI Instant Win Games]
addgame wrote symbols BTC…JUP and increment count to 1 (Pyth close prices were 0 because the feeds were older than 60 seconds)
evidence.functional_evidence: initvault, initgames and addgame all landed; the vault and games accounts were read back from devnet; a second initvault was rejected. close prices in addgame were zero because the Pyth feeds were stale.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet, then submit initvault / initgames / addgame). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same instructions were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/zeroai.mjs.

limitations: addgame succeeded but recorded closeprice [0,0,0,0,0,0] because the classic Pyth devnet feeds were older than the program's 60-second freshness window (it writes 0 when get_price_no_older_than returns None). closegame was not sent.
